mapper.select: SELECT department_id AS departmentId, COUNT(*) AS jobCount, SUM(hc_total) AS totalHeadCount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_urgent IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS urgentCount FROM rec_job_position WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY department_id
SELECT experience_level AS level, COUNT(*) AS jobCount, SUM(hc_total) AS totalHeadCount FROM rec_job_position WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY experience_level

SELECT j.department_id AS departmentId, COUNT(DISTINCT j.id) AS activeJobCount, COALESCE(SUM(j.hc_total), 0) AS plannedHeadCount, COALESCE(SUM(h.hiredCount), 0) AS hiredCount FROM rec_job_position j LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.job_position_id, COUNT(*) AS hiredCount FROM rec_resume r INNER JOIN rec_candidate c ON c.id = r.candidate_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE c.status = 5 GROUP BY r.job_position_id ) h ON h.job_position_id = j.id WHERE j.deleted = 0 AND j.status = 1 GROUP BY j.department_id
